candidates.label: Verbal testimony exposed as lying by divine counter-testimony
candidates.definition: In 63:1: When the hypocrites come to you O Muhammad they say we testify that you are the Messenger of Allah; and Allah knows that you are His Messenger and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

evidence.excerpt: إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُواْ نَشۡهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشۡهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Oaths weaponised as cover to obstruct the divine way
candidates.definition: In 63:2: They have taken their oaths as a cover so they averted people from the way of Allah; indeed it was evil that they were doing.

evidence.excerpt: ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيۡمَٰنَهُمۡ جُنَّةٗ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Belief then disbelief sealing hearts against understanding
candidates.definition: In 63:3: That is because they believed and then they disbelieved so their hearts were sealed over and they do not understand.

evidence.excerpt: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Propped-timber exterior masking paranoia and enmity
candidates.definition: In 63:4: And when you see them their forms please you and if they speak you listen to their speech; they are as if they were pieces of wood propped up, they think every shout is against them; they are the enemy so beware of them.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ تُعۡجِبُكَ أَجۡسَامُهُمۡۖ وَإِن يَقُولُواْ تَسۡمَعۡ لِقَوۡلِهِمۡۖ كَأَنَّهُمۡ خُشُبٞ مُّسَنَّدَةٞۖ يَحۡسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيۡحَةٍ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ هُمُ ٱلۡعَدُوُّ فَٱحۡذَرۡهُمۡۚ قَٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Forgiveness permanently withheld after arrogant refusal
candidates.definition: In 63:5-6: When it is said come the Messenger will ask forgiveness for you they turn their heads aside evading arrogantly; it is all the same whether you ask forgiveness for them or not, never will Allah forgive them, indeed Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ يَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوۡاْ رُءُوسَهُمۡ وَرَأَيۡتَهُمۡ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَسۡتَغۡفَرۡتَ لَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَهُمۡ لَن يَغۡفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Economic blockade attempt exposed by divine treasury ownership
candidates.definition: In 63:7: They are the ones who say do not spend on those with the Messenger of Allah until they disband; and to Allah belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth but the hypocrites do not understand.

evidence.excerpt: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُواْ عَلَىٰ مَنۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّواْۗ وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Honour belonging to Allah, His Messenger and believers alone
candidates.definition: In 63:8: They say if we return to al-Madinah the more honoured will surely expel the more humble; and to Allah belongs all honour and to His Messenger and to the believers but the hypocrites do not know.

evidence.excerpt: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعۡنَآ إِلَى ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ لَيُخۡرِجَنَّ ٱلۡأَعَزُّ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡأَذَلَّۚ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Wealth and children as diversions from remembrance producing loss
candidates.definition: In 63:9: O you who have believed let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah; and whoever does that then those are the losers.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلۡهِكُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Deathbed plea for delay to give charity declared impossible
candidates.definition: In 63:10-11: And spend from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says my Lord if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous; but never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
